newsitem.title: USA: Pulsar unit says Frankenberg named Encanto CEO.
newsitem.headline: Pulsar unit says Frankenberg named Encanto CEO.

text.p: Pulsar Venture Group said on Tuesday that Bob Frankenberg had been named as the chief executive of Encanto Networks Inc, a newly formed company that plans to develop a Java-based, "plug-and-go" Internet appliance.

Pulsar Venture Group is a unit of the privately held Pulsar Internacional and a majority financier for Encanto Networks. The Encanto appliance will be designed to help consumers and small businesses maintain their own websites, Pulsar Venture said in a statement.
Frankenberg joins the company after resigning as chief executive from Novell Inc in August 1996 after more than two year leading the struggling computer software company.
